scope: Internal scheduler callback interruption in the target execution context. Public Bordeaux Threads thread lifecycle/identity/join/interrupt adapters remain separate work.

implementation.activations: Each scheduler handle has a stack of ResumableTask activations sharing its execution context and a queue of callbacks. The target retains its dynamic bindings/call stack while callbacks run and may suspend.
implementation.waits: Each activation tracks pending operations, state and wait version independently. Original promise completion during a callback is saved until that activation resumes. Callback failure invalidates the parent wait and throws through the parent iterator.
implementation.values: Normal callbacks restore saved values. Exceptional callbacks retain the current transferred values for RETURN-FROM/THROW while parent cleanup runs.
implementation.cancellation: Discard queued callbacks; schedule cancellation through all existing activations. Unwind active callbacks first, then parents; asynchronous cleanup can await.
implementation.self: The JavaScript scheduler interrupt method queues delivery at the next suspension. Public Lisp self-interrupt needs a direct resumable call path to run before its caller continues.
